name: skydog-gps
description: SkyDog GPS — adventure tracker by SkyDog AI

scripts.ios:setup: npm install && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json sw.js icon-192.png icon-512.png apple-touch-icon.png favicon.png skydog-logo.png www/ && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.check:sync: diff -q index.html www/index.html && diff -q index.html ios/App/App/public/index.html && diff -q index.html android/app/src/main/assets/public/index.html && echo '✅ built copies match root index.html'
scripts.android:sync: mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json sw.js icon-192.png icon-512.png apple-touch-icon.png favicon.png skydog-logo.png www/ && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease

author: SkyDog
